<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

This project is a Vite + React + TypeScript website to showcase paintings as photos. 
Use a dark gray palette, beautiful fonts, and responsive design. Support both French and English. 
Use animated transitions for expanding images and a stylish info box overlay. Footer should include social media links. 
There is an About page for the artist.

When a new image is added, make sure the developer provides a localized title and description as well as a link to the new image.
Update the en.json and fr.json accordingly after adding the new image to the PAINTINGS collection in the paintings.ts file as well as in the painting grid.
An image can be removed using its id only. Yo should be able to update the grid and the unused localized texts as well.
